newsitem.title: USA: Mckesson Corp Q3 Oper shr falls to $0.57.
newsitem.headline: Mckesson Corp Q3 Oper shr falls to $0.57.

text.p: Gain on sale of Armor All 120.2 -
Gain on sale of Armor All 2.70 -
NOTES: (1) Restated to reflect the Armor All and Millbrook segments as discontinued operations.
(2) U.S. Health Care has been restated to exclude sales and cost of sales associated with sales to customers' warehouses and include only the gross margin on such sales in revenues.

(3) FY 1997 includes $92 million in costs primarily associated with the integration and rationalization of the FoxMeyer and McKesson distribution operations, systems, program offerings and administrative functions. The $92 million also includes reserves for receivables. In addition, the FY 1997 charge includes $48 million for the write-off of in-process purchased technology resulting from the completion of the valuation appraisal for the April 1996 acquisition of Automated Healthcare, Inc. and a write-down of $7 million for the assets of the Aqua-Vend unit.
(4) Includes taxes on income from continuing operations before special items of $13.3 million and an income tax benefit of $37.5 million on special items.
